inscription-balance-modal.description.text: You have {amount} {symbol} inscribed. If you want to spend it you need to unlock it from Settings.

send-tx.desc.contract.text: Runs the contract call below from your wallet. Review the recipient and the amount before you confirm.

send-tx.desc.send.text: Sends from your wallet to the address below.

send-tx.set-approval-for-all-revoke.text: This revokes an operator’s permission to transfer NFTs in this collection.

send-tx.set-approval-for-all-warning.text: This grants the operator below permission to transfer ALL NFTs you own in this collection. Only approve if you fully trust this site.

send-tx.token-transfer-warning.text: This transaction sends tokens out of your wallet. Verify the token, amount and recipient below before approving.

send.confirm.bitcoin-dust-error.text: Unable to prepare the transaction due to a dust error. Learn more

send.confirm.insufficient-funds.text: Insufficient funds, please try again with a larger amount.

send.confirm.ledger-solana-blockhash-exp.text: The transaction expired while waiting for your Ledger. Confirm it again on the device.

send.confirm.simulation-network.text: Couldn't verify the transaction due to a network issue. Check your connection and try again.

send.confirm.simulation-reverted.text: This transaction can't be completed right now — it was rejected during simulation. If you just approved a token, wait a few seconds and try again.

send.confirm.staking-transaction-not-sup.text: Staking transactions are not supported on hardware wallets.

send.confirm.wasm-desync.text: Trust Wallet was updated in the background and needs a quick restart to finish. It will restart automatically — please try again right after.

send.confirmation.hot-wallet-memo-requir.text: A memo is required when sending to this exchange address. Go back and add a memo, or your funds may be lost.

send.confirmation.risk.high-risk-inline.text: This address has been identified as potentially risky.

send.confirmation.risk.hot-wallet-memo.text: This looks like an exchange deposit address. It will need a memo/tag.

send.confirmation.risk.sanctioned.text: This recipient address is restricted or has been flagged as fraudulent.

send.confirmation.risk.smart-contract.text: This address belongs to a smart contract. Sending tokens directly to a contract may result in permanent loss.

send.confirmation.risk.unavailable.text: We couldn't check this recipient right now. Double-check the address before continuing.

transaction.still-pending.body.text: It's taking longer than usual to confirm. You can check its status on the block explorer, or learn what to do if it stays stuck.
